note: Run 86: province calibration. Run 85 slowed all idea diffusion to 0.7 on provinces: the farming fronts came into band (Central Europe 97%, Britain 81%) but writing, iron, coin and paper came later still and 1 CE population fell to 126M. Now only farming spreads at 0.7 (fd70), with writing three or six times as readily (wr3, wr6): province states form near their real dates, about 2,400 years after the grid's, and the writing rate was set for the grid's early states. Provinces also measure caravan crossings by distance.
